title: Rebel Trooper
caption: Rebel Trooper (V)
game_text: _When drawn for weapon or battle destiny, destiny +2._ While present at a site and armed with a blaster rifle, forfeit +2 and draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
lore: Corellian Corvette trooper Ensign Chad Hilse, an Alderaanian, typifies the loyal Rebel volunteers dedicated to defeating the Empire. Trained in starship and ground combat.
